scenario_config.scenario_description: Create a General Inquiry HR case for the annual performance review rollout, link the relevant knowledge article, add a Teams channel tab with guidance, and announce the kickoff with the HR case reference.
scenario_config.prompt: Create a General Inquiry HR case to track the annual performance review rollout and link the Annual Performance Review Guide knowledge article to it for manager reference. In the ServiceNow Community team, add a website tab named "Performance Review Guide" to the product feedback channel that displays the official performance review guidance at https://www.company.com/hr/performance-review-guide. Post a message in the same channel announcing the performance review kickoff, including the HR case number.

verifier_configs.name: Annual Performance Review HR Case Created
verifier_configs.description: Verify that a draft General Inquiry HR case for the Annual Performance Review rollout was created.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM hr_case WHERE opened_by = 39 AND hr_service = 1 AND status = 'draft' AND short_description LIKE '%Annual%' AND short_description LIKE '%Performance%' AND short_description LIKE '%Review%'

verifier_configs.name: Performance Review Knowledge Linked To HR Case
verifier_configs.description: Verify that the Annual Performance Review Guide knowledge article is linked to the HR case.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM hr_case_knowledge WHERE hr_case_id = (SELECT hr_case_id FROM hr_case WHERE opened_by = 39 AND hr_service = 1 AND state = 'draft' AND short_description LIKE '%Annual%' AND short_description LIKE '%Performance%' AND short_description LIKE '%Review%' LIMIT 1) AND knowledge_id = 6 AND org_id = 1

verifier_configs.name: Performance Review Guide Tab Added To Channel
verifier_configs.description: Verify that a website tab named 'Performance Review Guide' was added to the product feedback channel.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM teams_channel_tabs WHERE team_id = 'team_servicenow_public' AND channel_id = 'sn_public_standard_01' AND display_name = 'Performance Review Guide'

verifier_configs.name: Performance Review Kickoff Message Posted
verifier_configs.description: Verify that a kickoff announcement message was posted in the product feedback channel mentioning the Annual Performance Review.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM channel_messages WHERE team_id = 'team_servicenow_public' AND channel_id = 'sn_public_standard_01' AND body_json LIKE '%Annual%' AND body_json LIKE '%Performance%' AND body_json LIKE '%Review%'

body.content:
🎯 Annual Performance Review Kickoff

Hello team,

We are pleased to announce the launch of our Annual Performance Review cycle! This is an important opportunity for all employees and managers to reflect on accomplishments, set goals, and align on development opportunities.

Key Information:

  • HR Case Number: HRC0000772
  • Resource: Please refer to the Annual Performance Review Guide knowledge article (KB0040006) for step-by-step instructions
  • Quick Access: We've added a new "Performance Review Guide" tab to this channel for easy reference

Managers, please review the guidance materials and reach out if you have any questions. Let's make this a productive and meaningful review cycle!

Thank you for your cooperation.
